name: PdxSplitter
description:
A layout of resizable panes the user resizes by dragging the handles between them or from the
keyboard, with collapsible and nested panes.

members.name: panes
members.description: Pane configurations — array matching child elements

members.name: autoSaveId
members.description: localStorage key for persistence (empty = no save)

members.name: getSizes
members.description: The pane sizes now, in percent of the space the gutters leave.

members.name: setSizes
members.description: Apply pane sizes, in percent, and save them when `auto-save-id` is set.

members.name: resetSizes
members.description: Forget the saved sizes and lay the panes out again from their props.

members.name: isDragging
members.description: Whether a divider is being dragged right now.

events.name: pdx-resize
events.description: The sizes changed: by a drag, the arrows, Home/End or a double-click; in percent.

events.name: pdx-resize-start
events.description: A drag began; the sizes before it.

events.name: pdx-resize-end
events.description: A drag ended; the sizes it left.

attributes.name: autosaveid
attributes.description: localStorage key for persistence (empty = no save)

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: pane
cssParts.description: One of the app's children, laid out as a pane (`.pdx-splitter-pane`).

cssParts.name: gutter
cssParts.description: The handle between two panes (`role="separator"`), dragged or moved with the arrows.

cssStates.name: dragging
cssStates.description: A gutter is being dragged: the panes take no pointer until it is let go.
